scope: Third two-iteration DROID LoRA smoke using attention-only rank 32
summary: Attention-only rank-32 LoRA reduced trainable parameters from 143,917,056 to 84,934,656 and reached the training forward pass, but shared physical GPU 1 still missed a 76 MiB allocation with only 35 MiB free.
evidence: The run injected Q/K/V/output adapters only, totaling 84,934,656 trainable parameters or 0.592 percent of the 14.35B model.
FSDP4, CP4, the 172-video dataset, optimizer, and training loop all initialized successfully.
Rank 1 failed on a 76 MiB LoRA linear allocation with 35 MiB free; no checkpoint was written.
lessons: Removing MLP adapters materially reduced the peak but a safe training configuration needs additional persistent-state headroom on the two shared 37 GiB GPUs.
Reducing rank from 32 to 16 halves adapter parameters, gradients, and optimizer state while retaining the complete attention target set.
limitations: No optimizer step completed; this attempt is not quality evidence.
next_actions: Run attention-only rank-16 smoke training in a new immutable directory.
